case_number: 2023 INSC 784; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2023 (@ OUT OF SLP (Crl.) No.2256/2022)
summary: Anticipatory bail cancellation appeal; accused declared proclaimed offender under IPC; alleged manipulation in investigation record; common name defense rejected; bail principles revisited: gravity, antecedents, flight risk; supervening circumstances standard for cancellation; precedents cited including Ram Govind Upadhyay, Prasanta Kumar Sarkar, Mahipal, Bhagwan Singh; bail order upheld due to lack of overwhelming grounds for cancellation.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s. 82, s. 438
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; anticipatory bail granted to respondent maintained; High Court order upholding bail confirmed.
